newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-PARTICIPANTS IN ALL-STAR WEEKEND.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-PARTICIPANTS IN ALL-STAR WEEKEND.

text.p: Participants for the National
Basketball Association's All-Star Weekend competitions at
Cleveland's Gund Arena on February 8:
SHOOTAROUND
Clyde Drexler, Houston; Tim Hardaway, Miami; Bobby Phills,
Cleveland, Mitch Richmond, Sacramento
THREE-POINT SHOOTOUT
Dale Ellis, Denver; Steve Kerr, Chicago; Tim Legler,
Washington; Terry Mills, Detroit; Sam Perkins, Seattle; Glen
Rice, Charlotte; John Stockton, Utah, Walt Williams, Toronto
SLAM-DUNK
Ray Allen, Milwaukee; Kobe Bryant, LA Lakers; Chris Carr,
Minnesota; Michael Finley, Dallas; Allen Iverson,
Philadelphia, Bob Sura, Cleveland
ROOKIE GAME
Eastern Conference
Ray Allen, Milwaukee; Marcus Camby, Toronto; Erick
Dampier, Indiana; Allen Iverson, Philadelphia; Kerry Kittles,
New Jersey; Vitaly Potapenko, Cleveland; Antoine Walker,
Boston, John Wallace, New York
Western Conference
Shareef Abdur-Rahim, Vancouver; Kobe Bryant, LA Lakers;
Travis Knight, LA Lakers; Matt Maloney, Houston; Stephon
Marbury, Minnesota; Steve Nash, Phoenix; Roy Rogers,
Vancouver, Samaki Walker, Dallas
